designRationale.visualConcept: Digital evidence docket meets contemporary Korean editorial design. Emphasizes authoritative, legal-grade typography, ruled margin annotations, crisp open rails, and structured visual evidence sheets instead of generic rounded bento card grids.
designRationale.artDirection: Paper-white neutral background with high-contrast deep ink text, accented by hot vermilion for prosecution claims, restrained cobalt for defense counter-arguments, and earned emerald green strictly reserved for verified champion states.
designRationale.hierarchyStrategy: Primary emphasis on live browser DOM/screenshot frame and pin points, secondary emphasis on AI prosecutor/defender citations, tertiary emphasis on gate outcomes (`통과`, `실패`, `측정 대기`). Made-up numeric quality scores are strictly banned.

designSystem.iconRules: Clean 1.5px outline style. No emojis, no filled decorative 3D icons, no arrow glyphs inside text.

dashboard.heading: 좋아졌다는 말 대신, 증거를 남깁니다.
dashboard.subtext: 같은 사용자 여정을 다시 실행하고, 회귀가 없을 때만 패치를 승격합니다.
dashboard.missionValue: 브랜드로 로그인하고 US 크리에이터 John Smith를 검토한 뒤 제안 금액을 수정해 전송 준비 상태로 만드세요.

court.heading: 결함은 주장으로 채택되기 전에 증명되어야 합니다.
court.verdict: 원시 OAuth 식별자가 노출되고, 제안 판단에 필요한 신뢰 근거가 비어 있음

comparison.heading: 같은 여정에서 더 나은 쪽을 먼저 고릅니다.

receipt.heading: CHAMPION
receipt.subtext: 이 패치는 같은 여정을 통과했고, 새로운 회귀를 만들지 않았습니다.

dashboard.layout: Top navigation bar (64px height) -> Sub-header with Workspace label & Run Rail -> Split viewport: Left Configuration Panel (400px), Right Live Evidence Log stream (976px).
dashboard.hierarchy: 1. Main Heading & Mission Configuration panel, 2. Run Rail progress indicator, 3. Live evidence stream.
dashboard.responsiveRules: Stack to single column under 1024px width.
dashboard.interactionNotes: Clicking '60초 데모 재생' triggers full deterministic timeline execution across all 6 rail stages.

court.layout: Header with Court Heading & Verdict Bar -> Left Column: Frame Inspector (800px) with interactive Pin overlay -> Right Column: Docket Sheet (576px) containing Prosecution, Defense, and Judge Verdict panels.
court.hierarchy: 1. Failing Browser Screenshot with interactive Pin markers, 2. Prosecution argument citing Pin IDs, 3. Defense response, 4. Judge summary.
court.responsiveRules: Frame Inspector stacks above Docket Sheet under 1024px.
court.interactionNotes: Hovering over Pin E-01 highlights matching citation line in Prosecution transcript.

comparison.layout: Header with Comparison Heading -> Dual Blind Frame Grid (Variant A vs Variant B) -> Per-Gate Matrix panel below -> Bottom Floating CTA '패치 정체 공개'.
comparison.hierarchy: 1. Blind Variant side-by-side frames, 2. Blind Gate checklist, 3. Reveal action button.
comparison.responsiveRules: Side-by-side frames turn into tabbed view on mobile viewports.
comparison.interactionNotes: Before reveal, variants are labelled strictly '변종 A' and '변종 B'. Clicking reveal highlights the patched version in emerald green.

receipt.layout: Centered Certificate Docket Frame (680px max width) on cool-neutral background. Contains Champion Seal header, Hash digest, Gate Matrix, Source Commit reference, and Action Toolbar.
receipt.hierarchy: 1. CHAMPION Header & Seal, 2. Verified Gate Results, 3. Hash & Commit Lineage, 4. Copy/Download Actions.
receipt.responsiveRules: Full width with 16px lateral padding on mobile.
receipt.interactionNotes: '영수증 복사' copies canonical JSON string to clipboard and shows toast notification.

mobile.layout: Single-column fluid layout with sticky top context bar showing Workspace ID and Stage badge, view toggle tabs (재판/증거/비교/영수증), collapsible detail panels.
mobile.hierarchy: 1. Active Stage Banner, 2. Primary Evidence Frame / Verdict, 3. Collapsible Arguments & Gates.
mobile.responsiveRules: Minimum 44px tap targets for all controls. Secondary logs collapsed by default.
mobile.interactionNotes: Horizontal swipe between Evidence Pin items.

RunRail.description: 6-stage horizontal progress rail with numeric step indicators and state badges.

EvidenceSheet.description: Ruled paper-style docket container for legal-formatted transcripts.

FrameInspector.description: Browser viewport simulator with DOM pinpoint overlays.

GateBadge.description: Deterministic status badge with explicit copy.

ChampionSeal.description: Immutable receipt stamp displaying execution timestamp and SHA-256 hash.

timeline.action: User clicks '60초 데모 재생'. Browser agent loads target http://localhost:4174 for BU01 mission.
Agent replays path: Login -> Creator Directory -> Filter US -> Select John Smith.
Prosecutor cites E-01 (raw OAuth id exposed) & E-02 (0 followers / TBD). Defender accepts raw ID defect.
System applies single atomic patch: masks OAuth ID, injects trust metrics, ensures mobile action clearance.
Replay exact mission on patched code. Blind comparison evaluates Variant A vs Variant B.
All gates pass ('통과'). Patch promoted to CHAMPION status. Immutable signed receipt generated.

accessibility.wcagContrast: AA compliant across all text tokens (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text).
accessibility.keyboardNavigation: Full tab ordering across primary navigation tabs, CTA buttons, and evidence pin triggers.
accessibility.touchTargetSize: Minimum 44px x 44px on all interactive controls.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Disables stage transition slide effects and pin pulsers when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

acceptanceChecklist: 1. Brand name 'PATCHCOURT' displayed accurately.
2. Workspace label 'BU01 / 브랜드-크리에이터 제안 여정' clearly visible.
3. Primary CTA '증거 재판 시작' present.
4. Secondary CTA '60초 데모 재생' triggers automated demo flow.
5. Live log shows exact candidate URL 'http://localhost:4174'.
6. Exact mission text rendered accurately.
7. Six distinct stage names displayed in order on Run Rail.
8. Pin E-01 highlights raw OAuth ID defect in Court view.
9. Pin E-02 highlights missing trust evidence defect.
10. Prosecutor AI argument uses vermilion accent style.
11. Defender AI response uses cobalt accent style.
12. Gate labels match specified Korean copy exactly.
13. Gate statuses use only '통과', '실패', or '측정 대기'.
14. No arbitrary numeric scores appear anywhere in UI.
15. Blind comparison hides variant identities until reveal button is clicked.
16. Reveal action highlights patched version as CHAMPION.
17. Champion receipt displays immutable receipt hash digest.
18. Action '영수증 복사' copies JSON payload.
19. Mobile view (390x844) preserves core verdict and pass/fail statuses.
20. Interface uses editorial docket aesthetic with ruled borders and paper-white canvas.
